function jx810TreasureChance(){
 const lucky=jx812LuckyRod();
 const base=lucky?.075:.06;
 return Math.min(.14,base*(1+jx811ExtraTreasureBonus('treasureChance')));
}
function jx810MutationItems(area){
 const items=area.pool.filter(item=>JX808_MUTATION_NAMES.has(item[1]));
 const secret=jx785Secrets[area.id];
 if(secret&&JX808_MUTATION_NAMES.has(secret[1]))items.push(secret);
 return items;
}
function jx810MutationChance(areaId,pity=progress.mutationPity){
 const base=JX810_MUTATION_BASE[areaId]||.03;
 const n=Math.max(0,Number(pity)||0);
 const mult=n>=60?3.5:n>=40?2.25:n>=20?1.5:1;
 const treasureBoost=areaId==='cursed'?1+jx811ExtraTreasureBonus('cursedMutation'):1;
 return Math.min(.18,base*mult*treasureBoost*jx812MutationMult());
}
function jx810ShinyChance(item,pity=progress.shinyPity){
 if(!jx785CanShiny(item))return 0;
 const base=JX785_SHINY_RATE[item[2]]||.05;
 const n=Math.max(0,Number(pity)||0);
 const mult=n>=75?3:n>=50?2:n>=25?1.4:1;
 const worldBoost=currentArea?.id==='night'?1+jx811ExtraTreasureBonus('nightShiny'):1;
 return Math.min(.35,base*mult*(1+jx785FindBonus('shiny'))*worldBoost*jx812ShinyMult());
}
function jx810MutationShare(areaId,name){
 const table=JX810_MUTATION_WEIGHTS[areaId]||{};
 const total=Object.values(table).reduce((a,b)=>a+Number(b||0),0)||1;
 return Number(table[name]||0)/total;
}
function jx810NormalShare(areaId,name){
 const table=JX810_FIXED_POOL_WEIGHTS[areaId]||{};
 const total=Object.values(table).reduce((a,b)=>a+Number(b||0),0)||1;
 return Number(table[name]||0)/total;
}
function jx810BaseCatchChance(area,item){
 if(!area||!item)return 0;
 const treasure=.06;
 if(item[3]==='treasure')return treasure/Math.max(1,area.pool.filter(x=>x[3]==='treasure').length);
 const mutationBase=JX810_MUTATION_BASE[area.id]||.03;
 if(JX808_MUTATION_NAMES.has(item[1])){
  return (1-treasure)*mutationBase*jx810MutationShare(area.id,item[1]);
 }
 return (1-treasure)*(1-mutationBase)*jx810NormalShare(area.id,item[1]);
}
function jx810Pct(v){
 const n=Math.max(0,Number(v)||0)*100;
 return (n>=10?n.toFixed(1):n.toFixed(2)).replace(/\.00$/,'').replace(/(\.\d)0$/,'$1')+'%';
}

function jx816WorldCounts(area){
 const normal=area.pool.filter(f=>(f[3]==='fish'||f[3]==='creature')&&!JX808_MUTATION_NAMES.has(f[1]));
 const mutations=area.pool.filter(f=>JX808_MUTATION_NAMES.has(f[1]));
 const secret=jx785Secrets[area.id];
 if(secret&&JX808_MUTATION_NAMES.has(secret[1]))mutations.push(secret);
 const treasures=area.pool.filter(f=>f[3]==='treasure');
 const normalGot=normal.filter(f=>jx785BookEntry(area.id,f[1])?.count>0).length;
 const shinyGot=normal.filter(f=>jx785ShinyEntry(area.id,f[1])?.count>0).length;
 const mutationGot=mutations.filter(f=>jx785BookEntry(area.id,f[1])?.count>0).length;
 const treasureGot=treasures.filter(f=>jx785BookEntry(area.id,f[1])?.count>0).length;
 return {
  normalGot,normalTotal:normal.length,
  shinyGot,shinyTotal:normal.length,
  mutationGot,mutationTotal:mutations.length,
  treasureGot,treasureTotal:treasures.length,
  complete:normalGot===normal.length&&shinyGot===normal.length&&mutationGot===mutations.length&&treasureGot===treasures.length
 };
}
function jx816GlobalRecord(){
 let best={name:'—',weight:0,area:''};
 for(const area of areas)for(const item of [...area.pool,jx785Secrets[area.id]].filter(Boolean)){
  const n=jx785BookEntry(area.id,item[1]),s=jx785ShinyEntry(area.id,item[1]);
  const w=Math.max(Number(n?.bestWeight)||0,Number(s?.bestWeight)||0);
  if(w>best.weight)best={name:item[1],weight:w,area:area.id};
 }
 return best;
}
function jx816MostCaught(){
 const sums=new Map();
 for(const area of areas)for(const item of [...area.pool,jx785Secrets[area.id]].filter(Boolean)){
  const n=Number(jx785BookEntry(area.id,item[1])?.count)||0,s=Number(jx785ShinyEntry(area.id,item[1])?.count)||0;
  sums.set(item[1],(sums.get(item[1])||0)+n+s);
 }
 let best={name:'—',count:0};
 for(const [name,count] of sums)if(count>best.count)best={name,count};
 return best;
}

function jx811TreasureEffect(areaId,name){

function jx809MasterProgress(){
 let normalGot=0,normalTotal=0,shinyGot=0,shinyTotal=0,mutGot=0,mutTotal=0;
 for(const area of areas){
  const normalItems=jx807AreaSpecies(area);
  for(const item of normalItems){
   normalTotal++;
   if(jx785BookEntry(area.id,item[1])?.count)normalGot++;
   shinyTotal++;
   if(jx785ShinyEntry(area.id,item[1])?.count)shinyGot++;
  }
  const allItems=[...area.pool];
  if(jx785Secrets[area.id])allItems.push(jx785Secrets[area.id]);
  for(const item of allItems){
   if(!JX808_MUTATION_NAMES.has(item[1]))continue;
   mutTotal++;
   if(jx807SpeciesCaught(area.id,item))mutGot++;
  }
 }
 const legendaryGot=JX785_LEGENDARY_FINDS.filter(x=>jx785HasFind(x.id)).length,legendaryTotal=JX785_LEGENDARY_FINDS.length;
 return {
  normalGot,normalTotal,shinyGot,shinyTotal,mutGot,mutTotal,legendaryGot,legendaryTotal,
  complete:normalGot===normalTotal&&shinyGot===shinyTotal&&mutGot===mutTotal&&legendaryGot===legendaryTotal
 };
}

function jx808FindSpecies(areaId,name){
 const area=areas.find(a=>a.id===areaId);if(!area)return null;
 const item=area.pool.find(f=>f[1]===name)||(jx785Secrets[areaId]?.[1]===name?jx785Secrets[areaId]:null);
 return item?{area,item}:null;
}
function jx808VariantEntries(kind){
 const rows=[];
 for(const area of areas){
  if(kind==='shiny'){
   const items=area.pool.filter(item=>(item[3]==='fish'||item[3]==='creature')&&!JX808_MUTATION_NAMES.has(item[1]));
   for(const item of items){
    const entry=jx785ShinyEntry(area.id,item[1]);
    if(entry?.count)rows.push({area,item,entry,shiny:true,mutation:false,locked:false});
   }
  }else if(kind==='mutation'){
   const orderedNames=Object.keys(JX810_MUTATION_WEIGHTS[area.id]||{});
   for(const name of orderedNames){
    const item=area.pool.find(x=>x[1]===name)||(jx785Secrets[area.id]?.[1]===name?jx785Secrets[area.id]:null);
    if(!item)continue;
    const entry=jx785BookEntry(area.id,name);
    rows.push({area,item,entry,shiny:false,mutation:true,locked:!entry?.count});
   }
  }
 }
 return rows;
}

 title.innerHTML='<strong>'+(kind==='shiny'?'✨ SHINY COLLECTION':'☣ MUTATION / ANOMALY LOG')+'</strong><span>'+(kind==='mutation'?discovered:rows.length)+' DISCOVERED'+(kind==='mutation'?' / '+total:'')+'</span>';
 host.append(title);
 const grid=document.createElement('div');grid.className='jx808-variant-grid';
 for(const row of rows){

  const sprite=document.createElement('span');sprite.className='sprite'+(kind==='shiny'?' jx811-ambient-shiny':'')+((row.item[2]==='SECRET')?' jx813-gold-sprite jx814-gold-sprite-fx':'');
  const img=document.createElement('img');jx785ApplySprite(img,row.item,kind==='shiny');img.alt=row.locked?'Undiscovered mutation silhouette':(kind==='shiny'?'Shiny ':'')+row.item[1];if(row.locked){img.classList.add('jx817-locked-mutation-sprite');img.dataset.locked='1'}sprite.append(img);
  const name=document.createElement('strong');name.textContent=row.locked?'??? MUTATION':row.item[1];
  const info=document.createElement('span');

  card.append(sprite,name,info);if(!row.locked&&!jx816Seen(jx816EntryKey(row.area.id,row.item[1],kind==='shiny'))){const nb=document.createElement('b');nb.className='jx816-new-badge';nb.textContent='NEW!';card.append(nb)}grid.append(card);
 }
 host.append(grid);
 if(!rows.length){const empty=document.createElement('div');empty.className='jx753-book-empty';empty.textContent=kind==='shiny'?'No shiny fish caught yet.':'No mutations configured.';host.append(empty)}

 jx777History();
}

function jx808FishDescription(area,item,shiny=false){
 if(JX808_FISH_LORE[item[1]])return JX808_FISH_LORE[item[1]]+(shiny?' This specimen is a documented SHINY variant.':'');
 const world={
  pond:'A freshwater species recorded in the Pond.',
  canal:'A hardy species adapted to the artificial Canal environment.',
  night:'A nocturnal species from Night Lake.',
  cursed:'A hostile or altered species from the Cursed Sea.'
 }[area.id]||'A documented Fishing.EXE species.';
 return world+(shiny?' This specimen is a rare SHINY colour variant.':'');
}
function jx808Inspect(areaId,name,shiny=false){
 const found=jx808FindSpecies(areaId,name);if(!found)return;
 const {area,item}=found,normal=jx785BookEntry(areaId,name),shine=jx785ShinyEntry(areaId,name),isMutation=JX808_MUTATION_NAMES.has(name),entry=shiny?shine:normal;
 if(!entry)return;const inspectKey=jx816EntryKey(areaId,name,shiny);jx816MarkSeen(inspectKey);
 let modal=$('jx808Inspect');

function chooseFish(){
 const pool=currentArea.pool;

 // 1) TREASURE — separate roll, unchanged.
 const treasures=pool.filter(item=>item[3]==='treasure');
 if(treasures.length&&Math.random()<jx810TreasureChance()){
  const weighted=treasures.map(item=>{
   const discovered=!!jx785BookEntry(currentArea.id,item[1])?.count;
   return {item,w:discovered?1:4};
  });
  const total=weighted.reduce((n,o)=>n+o.w,0);
  let roll=Math.random()*total;
  for(const o of weighted){roll-=o.w;if(roll<=0)return o.item}
  return weighted[weighted.length-1].item;
 }

 // 2) MUTATION — independent base chance with pity.
 const mutations=jx810MutationItems(currentArea);
 if(mutations.length&&Math.random()<jx810MutationChance(currentArea.id)){
  const table=JX810_MUTATION_WEIGHTS[currentArea.id]||{};
  const weighted=mutations.map(item=>({item,w:Number(table[item[1]]||1)}));
  const total=weighted.reduce((n,o)=>n+o.w,0);
  let roll=Math.random()*total;
  for(const o of weighted){roll-=o.w;if(roll<=0)return o.item}
  return weighted[weighted.length-1].item;
 }

 // 3) NORMAL / OTHER — exact fixed table, no duplicate or last-catch modifier.
 const normalPool=pool.filter(item=>item[3]!=='treasure'&&!JX808_MUTATION_NAMES.has(item[1]));
 const table=JX810_FIXED_POOL_WEIGHTS[currentArea.id]||{};
 const weighted=normalPool.map(item=>({item,w:Number(table[item[1]]||0)})).filter(o=>o.w>0);
 if(!weighted.length)return normalPool[Math.floor(Math.random()*normalPool.length)]||pool[0];
 const total=weighted.reduce((n,o)=>n+o.w,0);
 let roll=Math.random()*total;
 for(const o of weighted){roll-=o.w;if(roll<=0)return o.item}
 return weighted[weighted.length-1].item;
}

function jx8087CatchFX(mode='normal'){
 const host=$('jx8086CatchFx');if(!host)return;
 host.replaceChildren();host.className='jx8086-catch-fx '+mode;
 const isShiny=mode==='shiny',isMutation=mode==='mutation',isGold=mode==='treasure';
 const count=isGold?20:isMutation?18:isShiny?16:9;
 for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
  const s=document.createElement('i');
  s.className='jx8086-star';
  const a=(Math.PI*2*i/count)+(Math.random()*.45-.225);
  const d=(isGold?78:isMutation?72:isShiny?70:48)+Math.random()*(isGold?85:isMutation?75:isShiny?70:42);
  s.style.setProperty('--dx',Math.cos(a)*d+'px');
  s.style.setProperty('--dy',Math.sin(a)*d+'px');
  s.style.setProperty('--delay',(Math.random()*.18)+'s');
  s.style.setProperty('--scale',(0.65+Math.random()*1.0).toFixed(2));
  if(isGold)s.textContent=Math.random()>.45?'✦':'◆';
  else if(isMutation)s.textContent=Math.random()>.5?'✧':'✣';
  else if(isShiny)s.textContent=Math.random()>.45?'✦':'✧';
  else s.textContent=Math.random()>.5?'★':'✦';
  host.append(s);
 }
 if(isShiny||isGold){
  const swoosh=document.createElement('span');swoosh.className='jx8086-swoosh';
  const swoosh2=document.createElement('span');swoosh2.className='jx8086-swoosh second';
  host.append(swoosh,swoosh2);
 }
 if(isMutation){
  const aura=document.createElement('span');aura.className='jx8087-mutation-aura';
  const glitch=document.createElement('span');glitch.className='jx8087-mutation-ring';
  host.append(aura,glitch);
 }
 if(isGold){
  const flare=document.createElement('span');flare.className='jx8087-gold-flare';
  const halo=document.createElement('span');halo.className='jx8087-gold-halo';
  host.append(flare,halo);
 }
 requestAnimationFrame(()=>host.classList.add('play'));
 setTimeout(()=>host.classList.remove('play'),1700);
}

function jx815LoopOriginalCatchFX(host,mode='shiny'){
 if(!host)return;
 host.classList.add('jx815-original-catch-loop-host');

 // Avoid duplicate loop controllers on the same live node.
 if(host._jx815LoopMode===mode&&host._jx815LoopActive)return;
 host._jx815LoopMode=mode;
 host._jx815LoopActive=true;

 const run=()=>{
  if(!host.isConnected){host._jx815LoopActive=false;return}

  let fx=host.querySelector(':scope > .jx815-original-catch-loop');
  if(!fx){
   fx=document.createElement('div');
   fx.className='jx8086-catch-fx jx815-original-catch-loop';
   fx.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
   host.prepend(fx);
  }

  // Exact same construction as jx8087CatchFX(), only with this host.
  fx.replaceChildren();
  fx.className='jx8086-catch-fx jx815-original-catch-loop '+mode;

  const isShiny=mode==='shiny',isMutation=mode==='mutation',isGold=mode==='treasure';
  const count=isGold?20:isMutation?18:isShiny?16:9;
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
   const s=document.createElement('i');
   s.className='jx8086-star';
   const a=(Math.PI*2*i/count)+(Math.random()*.45-.225);
   const d=(isGold?78:isMutation?72:isShiny?70:48)+Math.random()*(isGold?85:isMutation?75:isShiny?70:42);
   s.style.setProperty('--dx',Math.cos(a)*d+'px');

function tick(ts){
 if(!['hook','drill'].includes(phase))return;
 if(!last)last=ts;
 const dt=Math.min(.05,(ts-last)/1000);last=ts;
 if(phase==='hook'){
  strikePos=.5+.43*Math.sin(ts/((currentArea.id==='night'?720:850)-progress.rod*30));
  strikeCooldown=Math.max(0,strikeCooldown-dt);syncTiming();frame=requestAnimationFrame(tick);return;
 }
 if(Math.floor(ts/4200)!==Math.floor((ts-34)/4200))jx799LeapFish(ts);
 const hard=jx810TrackDifficulty(),mastery=rodMasteryLevel(progress.rod);
 const speed=(1050/(hard*(1+progress.rod*.015)))*(currentArea.id==='night'?.90:1);
 const target=.5+.34*Math.sin(ts/speed+jx810FishSeed)+.13*Math.sin(ts/(speed*.37)+jx810FishSeed*1.7)+.05*Math.sin(ts/(speed*.16));
 const fishResponse=(1.8+hard*1.25)*dt;
 jx810FishPos+=(jx810Clamp(target,.045,.955)-jx810FishPos)*Math.min(1,fishResponse);
 jx810FishPos=jx810Clamp(jx810FishPos,.035,.965);
 const accel=jx810Hold?1.65:-1.52;
 jx810ZoneVel+=accel*dt;
 jx810ZoneVel*=Math.pow(.32,dt);
 jx810ZonePos+=jx810ZoneVel*dt;
 const half=jx810ZoneWidth/2;
 if(jx810ZonePos<half){jx810ZonePos=half;jx810ZoneVel=Math.max(0,jx810ZoneVel*.25)}
 if(jx810ZonePos>1-half){jx810ZonePos=1-half;jx810ZoneVel=Math.min(0,jx810ZoneVel*.25)}
 const dist=Math.abs(jx810FishPos-jx810ZonePos),inside=dist<=half;
 const control=(currentArea.id==='pond'?jx811ExtraTreasureBonus('pondControl'):0)+(currentArea.id==='night'?jx785FindBonus('nightControl'):0)+(currentArea.id==='cursed'?jx785FindBonus('cursedControl'):0);
 if(inside){
  const centerBonus=1+Math.max(0,1-dist/Math.max(.001,half))*.35;
  catchProgress=Math.min(100,catchProgress+dt*(18+progress.rod*2.4)*(1+mastery*.025)*(1+jx785FindBonus('reel'))*(1+control)*centerBonus*jx812ReelMult()/hard);
  jx810Lock=Math.min(100,jx810Lock+dt*(18+progress.rod*1.5+mastery*1.2)*jx812LockRecoveryMult());
 }else{
  catchProgress=Math.max(0,catchProgress-dt*(5.5+hard*2.6));
  const escapeDrain=(15+hard*7)*(1-jx785FindBonus('tension'))*(currentArea.id==='cursed'?1.12:1)*jx812DrainMult();
  jx810Lock=Math.max(0,jx810Lock-dt*escapeDrain);
 }
 jx810RenderTrack();
 if(jx810Lock<=0){miss('FISH ESCAPED · You lost control of the catch zone');return}
 if(catchProgress>=100){finish();return}
 updateButtons();frame=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}

if(battle.phase==='attack'||battle.phase==='defend'){const dt=Math.min(.05,(now-(battlePrev||now))/1000);const def=enemyDefs[battle.type],hpRatio=battle.enemyHP/def.hp,enrage=def.special==='enrage'&&hpRatio<.5?1.38:1,ritual=def.special==='ritual'?1+Math.min(.36,(battle.turn-1)*.055):1,curse=def.special==='curse'&&battle.turn>=4?1.18:1;const pattern=def.attackPattern||'steady';let patternMult=1;if(pattern==='rush')patternMult=1.05+.35*(.5+.5*Math.sin(now/155));else if(pattern==='stutter')patternMult=Math.sin(now/115)>.25?1.42:.58;else if(pattern==='ooze')patternMult=.72+.58*(.5+.5*Math.sin(now/330));else if(pattern==='pounce')patternMult=.86+.72*Math.pow(Math.abs(battle.pos-.5)*2,1.35);else if(pattern==='feint'||pattern==='mimic')patternMult=Math.sin(now/205)>.48?1.52:.78;else if(pattern==='berserk')patternMult=1+Math.min(.48,(battle.turn-1)*.055);else if(pattern==='guarded'||pattern==='stone'||pattern==='heavy')patternMult=.86;else if(pattern==='inferno')patternMult=1.12+(battle.turn%3===0?.23:0);else if(pattern==='phase')patternMult=.88+.48*(.5+.5*Math.sin(now/235));else if(pattern==='curse')patternMult=1.04+(battle.bossPhase>=2?.16:0)+(battle.bossPhase>=3?.16:0);if(battle.type==='gargoyle'&&battle.bossPhase>=2)patternMult*=battle.bossPhase>=3?1.34:1.18;battle.pos+=battle.dir*dt*(battle.phase==='attack'?.83:1.04)*def.speed*enrage*ritual*curse*patternMult;const movingZone=battle.timingType==='shift'||pattern==='phase'||(def.special==='curse'&&battle.bossPhase>=2);if(movingZone){const amp=def.special==='curse'&&battle.bossPhase>=3?.19:.14;battle.zoneCenter=.5+Math.sin(now/(pattern==='phase'?330:430))*amp;paintTimingZone()}if(battle.pos>=1){battle.pos=1;battle.dir=-1}if(battle.pos<=0){battle.pos=0;battle.dir=1}$('jx764Needle').style.left='calc('+(battle.pos*100)+'% - 2px)'}battlePrev=now;

function combatSpecialLabel(){if(!battle)return '';const def=enemyDefs[battle.type],r=battle.enemyHP/def.hp;if(battle.type==='gargoyle')return battle.bossPhase>=3?'BOSS PHASE III · SHATTER RAGE':battle.bossPhase>=2?'BOSS PHASE II · WING ASSAULT':'STONE SKIN · PERFECT / GUARD BREAK';if(battle.type==='lich')return battle.bossPhase>=3?'BOSS PHASE III · SOUL WARD':battle.bossPhase>=2?'BOSS PHASE II · CURSE SPIRAL':'GRAVE MAGIC · CURSE BUILDING';const names={spore_stun:'SPORE STUN · STUTTER ATTACK',toxic_pressure:'TOXIC PRESSURE · OOZE RHYTHM',rush:'RUSH · SPEED BURSTS',heavy_block:'HEAVY BLOCK · GUARD BREAK WORKS',pounce:'POUNCE · SPEED CHANGES',phase:'PHASE SHIFT · MOVING ZONE',heavy_strike:'HEAVY STRIKE · FEINT RHYTHM',berserk:'BERSERK · FASTER EACH ROUND',inferno:'INFERNO · NARROW CRIT ZONE',poison:'POISON BITE · MISS CAN POISON',root_skin:'ROOT SKIN · NORMAL HITS REDUCED',fear_shift:'FEAR SHIFT · MOVING TIMING',false_guard:'FALSE GUARD · MAY COUNTER',ritual:'RITUAL GROWTH · ESCALATES',enrage:'ENRAGE · FASTER BELOW 50%',stone_skin:'STONE SKIN',curse:'CURSE PHASES'};return names[def.special]||def.trait||'NO SPECIAL'}

function chooseEnemySpecial(){if(!battle)return '';const def=enemyDefs[battle.type],t=battle.turn;if(battle.type==='mushroom'&&Math.random()<.38)return 'spore';if(def.special==='toxic_pressure'&&t%3===0)return 'toxic';if(def.special==='rush'&&Math.random()<.38)return 'rush';if(def.special==='pounce'&&Math.random()<.36)return 'pounce';if(def.special==='phase'&&Math.random()<.35)return 'phase';if(def.special==='heavy_strike'&&Math.random()<.34)return 'heavy';if(def.special==='berserk'&&t>=3)return 'berserk';if(def.special==='inferno'&&t%3===0)return 'inferno';if(def.special==='poison'&&Math.random()<.4)return 'poison';if(def.special==='root_skin'&&t%3===0)return 'root';if(def.special==='fear_shift'&&Math.random()<.38)return 'fear';if(def.special==='false_guard'&&Math.random()<.35)return 'false_guard';if(def.special==='ritual'&&t%3===0)return 'ritual';if(def.special==='enrage'&&battle.enemyHP/def.hp<.5)return 'enrage';if(battle.type==='gargoyle'&&battle.bossPhase>=2)return battle.bossPhase>=3?'stone_rage':'dive';if(battle.type==='lich'&&battle.bossPhase>=2)return battle.bossPhase>=3?'soul_blast':'curse';return ''}

function resolveCombatAction(mode='normal'){if(!battle||battle.phase==='end'||battle.phase==='transition')return;const q=battleQuality(),attack=battle.phase==='attack',def=enemyDefs[battle.type];if(mode!=='normal'&&(battle.secondaryCooldown||0)>0)return;battle.phase='transition';$('jx764Action').disabled=true;if(tacticBtn)tacticBtn.disabled=true;if(mode!=='normal')battle.secondaryCooldown=2;
 if(attack){let dmg=q==='perfect'?30+Math.min(12,Number(petExtra.strength)||1):q==='good'?16+Math.floor((Number(petExtra.strength)||1)/3):0;let blocked=false,counter=0,bypassBlock=false,tacticLabel='';
  if(mode==='heavy'){tacticLabel='HEAVY HIT · ';dmg=q==='perfect'?Math.ceil(dmg*1.75):q==='good'?Math.ceil(dmg*1.35):0;}
  if(mode==='guard_break'){tacticLabel='GUARD BREAK · ';bypassBlock=q!=='miss';dmg=q==='perfect'?Math.ceil(dmg*1.4):q==='good'?Math.ceil(dmg*1.15):0;if(bypassBlock&&battle.type==='gargoyle')battle.stoneBroken=true;}
  if(battle.nextAttackBonus&&dmg>0){dmg+=battle.nextAttackBonus;tacticLabel+='DODGE COUNTER +'+battle.nextAttackBonus+' · ';battle.nextAttackBonus=0;}
  if(def.special==='root_skin'&&q!=='perfect'&&!bypassBlock&&dmg>0)dmg=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(dmg*.65));
  if((def.special==='stone_skin'||battle.type==='gargoyle')&&!battle.stoneBroken&&q!=='perfect'&&!bypassBlock&&dmg>0)dmg=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(dmg*(battle.bossPhase>=3?.38:.48)));
  if((def.special==='stone_skin'||battle.type==='gargoyle')&&(q==='perfect'||bypassBlock)){battle.stoneBroken=true;}
  const blockChance=battle.type==='skeleton'?.35:def.special==='heavy_block'?.38:battle.type==='gargoyle'?(battle.bossPhase>=3?.42:.28):0;
  if(!bypassBlock&&blockChance&&q!=='perfect'&&dmg>0&&Math.random()<blockChance){blocked=true;dmg=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(dmg*.38));}
  if(!bypassBlock&&def.special==='false_guard'&&q==='good'&&dmg>0&&Math.random()<.32){blocked=true;counter=6;dmg=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(dmg*.55));}
  if(battle.type==='lich'&&battle.bossPhase>=3&&battle.lichWard&&dmg>0){if(q==='perfect'||bypassBlock){battle.lichWard=false;tacticLabel+='SOUL WARD BROKEN · ';}else{dmg=0;blocked=true;battle.lichWard=false;tacticLabel+='SOUL WARD ABSORBS HIT · ';}}
  battle.enemyHP=Math.max(0,battle.enemyHP-dmg);if(counter)battle.hp=Math.max(0,battle.hp-counter);const bossCue=bossPhaseUpdate();
  battle.combo=q==='perfect'&&!blocked?battle.combo+1:q==='miss'?0:battle.combo;moveOrk('attack',520);if(dmg)moveEnemy(blocked?'block':'hurt',510);
  battleMessage.textContent=(bossCue?bossCue+' · ':'')+tacticLabel+(blocked?(def.name+' GUARDS · '+dmg+' DAMAGE'+(counter?' · COUNTER −'+counter+' HP':'')):q.toUpperCase()+' HIT · '+dmg+' DAMAGE');
  if(dmg){arena.classList.remove('jx-final-hurt','jx851-hit-shake');fighterStage.style.filter='none';fighterStage.style.opacity='1';void arena.offsetWidth;arena.classList.add('jx851-hit-shake');setTimeout(()=>arena.classList.remove('jx851-hit-shake'),180)}battleBars();
  later(()=>{if(battle.hp<=0){finishBattle(false);return}if(battle.enemyHP<=0){finishBattle(true);return}battle.enemySpecialAttack=chooseEnemySpecial();battle.stunAttack=battle.enemySpecialAttack==='spore';moveEnemy(battle.enemySpecialAttack?'special':'attack',800);phaseChange('defend');battleMessage.textContent=enemyAttackCue()+'! '+(def.special==='poison'?'AVOID THE PLAGUE BITE. ':def.special==='curse'&&battle.bossPhase>=2?'CURSE FIELD ACTIVE. ':'')+'TIME YOUR DEFENSE.'},580)
 } else {
  let dmg=q==='perfect'?0:q==='good'?Math.ceil(def.damage/2):def.damage;let defenseLabel='';
  if(mode==='dodge'){defenseLabel='DODGE · ';if(q==='perfect'){dmg=0;battle.nextAttackBonus=8;}else if(q==='good')dmg=0;else dmg=Math.ceil(def.damage*1.25);}
  const special=battle.enemySpecialAttack;
  if(special&&q==='miss'){if(['heavy','berserk','inferno','pounce','stone_rage','soul_blast'].includes(special))dmg=Math.ceil(dmg*1.22);if(special==='toxic')dmg+=4;}
  if(def.special==='poison'&&q==='miss'&&Math.random()<.55){battle.poisonTurns=2;}
  battle.hp=Math.max(0,battle.hp-dmg);moveOrk(dmg?'hurt':'defend',520);battleMessage.textContent=defenseLabel+(q==='perfect'?'PERFECT DEFENSE!'+(mode==='dodge'?' · COUNTER READY +8':''):q==='good'?(mode==='dodge'?'CLEAN DODGE · 0 DAMAGE':'PARTIAL BLOCK · −'+dmg+' HP'):(mode==='dodge'?'DODGE FAILED · −'+dmg+' HP':'BLOCK MISSED · −'+dmg+' HP'));battleBars();
  later(()=>{if(battle.hp<=0){finishBattle(false);return}if(battle.stunAttack&&q==='miss'&&mode!=='dodge'){battle.stunAttack=false;moveEnemy('stun',550);battle.hp=Math.max(0,battle.hp-5);battleBars();battleMessage.textContent='SPORE STUN · −5 HP · EXTRA ENEMY ATTACK';later(()=>{if(battle.hp<=0)finishBattle(false);else{battle.turn++;moveEnemy('attack',620);phaseChange('defend');battleMessage.textContent='STUNNED! BLOCK THE EXTRA ATTACK.'}},650)}else{battle.turn++;if(battle.secondaryCooldown>0)battle.secondaryCooldown--;if(battle.poisonTurns>0){battle.poisonTurns--;battle.hp=Math.max(0,battle.hp-4);battleBars();battleMessage.textContent='POISON · −4 HP'+(battle.poisonTurns?' · '+battle.poisonTurns+' TURN LEFT':'');if(battle.hp<=0){finishBattle(false);return}}battle.enemySpecialAttack='';phaseChange('attack');if(def.special==='enrage'&&battle.enemyHP/def.hp<.5)battleMessage.textContent='WEREWOLF ENRAGED · SPEED UP!';else if(def.special==='ritual'&&battle.turn%3===0)battleMessage.textContent='RITUAL POWER RISES · TIMING TIGHTENS!';else if(battle.type==='gargoyle'&&battle.bossPhase>=2)battleMessage.textContent=combatSpecialLabel();else if(battle.type==='lich'&&battle.bossPhase>=2)battleMessage.textContent=combatSpecialLabel();}},650)
 }}

function roomLayoutFor(file,mode){
 const base=ROOM_LAYOUTS[file]||ROOM_LAYOUTS.default;
 if(mode==='guardian'&&base.guardian)return {...ROOM_LAYOUTS.default.guardian,...base.guardian};
 if(mode==='enemy'&&base.enemy)return {...ROOM_LAYOUTS.default.enemy,...base.enemy};
 if(base.target)return {...ROOM_LAYOUTS.default.target,...base.target};
 return ROOM_LAYOUTS.default.target;
}
function roomMinerLayout(file){
 const base=ROOM_LAYOUTS[file]||ROOM_LAYOUTS.default;
 return {...ROOM_LAYOUTS.default.miner,...(base.miner||{})};
}
function applyRoomLayout(mode='node'){
 const roomFile=(run?.guardian?world().arena:(run?.room||world().bg?.[0]))||'';
 const miner=roomMinerLayout(roomFile);
 const target=roomLayoutFor(roomFile, mode);
 const m=$('jx900Miner'),n=$('jx900Node'),g=$('jx913Guardian'),toolEl=$('jx900ToolSprite'),haz=$('jx900Hazard'),fx=$('jx900ImpactFx'),pop=$('jx134LootPop'),room=$('jx900Room');
 if(room){
  room.style.setProperty('--jx-target-x',target.left+'%');
  room.style.setProperty('--jx-target-y',(100-(target.bottom||10)-(target.height||28)*.45)+'%');
 }
 if(m){m.style.left=miner.left+'%';m.style.bottom=miner.bottom+'%';m.style.width=miner.width+'%';m.style.maxWidth='170px';}
 if(toolEl){toolEl.style.left=(miner.left+Math.max(11,miner.width*.72))+'%';toolEl.style.bottom=(miner.bottom+8)+'%';toolEl.style.width=Math.max(10,miner.width*.50)+'%';}
 if(n){n.style.left=target.left+'%';n.style.right='auto';n.style.bottom=target.bottom+'%';n.style.width=target.width+'%';}
 if(g){g.style.left=target.left+'%';g.style.bottom=(target.bottom||0)+'%';g.style.width=(target.width||30)+'%';g.style.height=(target.height||34)+'%';g.style.transform='translateX(-50%)';}
 if(haz){haz.style.left=(target.left+8)+'%';haz.style.right='auto';haz.style.top='14%';}
 if(fx){fx.style.left=(target.left-2)+'%';fx.style.right='auto';fx.style.bottom=(Math.max(6,(target.bottom||12)-4))+'%';}
 if(pop){pop.style.left=(target.left-4)+'%';pop.style.right='auto';pop.style.bottom=(Math.max(14,(target.bottom||12)+8))+'%';}
}
function monsterChance(){return Math.min(.26,.10+dangerNow()*.0014+Math.max(0,(run?.depth||0)-1)*.008)}

function rnd(a){return a[Math.floor(Math.random()*a.length)]}
function clamp(v,a,b){return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v))}
function weighted(rows,rareBoost=1){
 let total=0;
 const adjusted=rows.map(([id,w])=>{let x=w;if(['gold','purple','red','void','fossil','relic'].includes(id))x*=rareBoost;total+=x;return [id,x]});
 let r=Math.random()*total;for(const [id,w] of adjusted){r-=w;if(r<=0)return id}return adjusted.at(-1)[0]
}

function secondaryFindChance(){
 if(!run)return 0;
 return Math.min(.42,.22+(run.focus||0)*.008+dangerNow()*.0013+(run.secondaryPity||0)*.025);
}
function rollSecondaryFind(nodeId){
 const pool=Object.entries(SECONDARY_ITEMS)
  .filter(([,o])=>o.world===state.world&&o.nodes.includes(nodeId));
 if(!pool.length)return null;
 if(Math.random()>=secondaryFindChance()){run.secondaryPity=Math.min(6,(run.secondaryPity||0)+1);return null}
 run.secondaryPity=0;
 const total=pool.reduce((s,[,o])=>s+o.weight,0);
 let r=Math.random()*total;
 for(const [id,o] of pool){r-=o.weight;if(r<=0)return {id,...o}}
 const [id,o]=pool.at(-1);return {id,...o};
}

function dangerLabel(v){
 if(v<25)return ['STABLE','stable'];
 if(v<50)return ['UNSTABLE','unstable'];
 if(v<75)return ['DANGEROUS','dangerous'];
 return ['CRITICAL','critical'];
}
function lootRarity(id){
 if(SECONDARY_ITEMS[id]?.rarity)return SECONDARY_ITEMS[id].rarity;
 if(['stone','coal'].includes(id))return 'common';
 if(['copper','iron'].includes(id))return 'uncommon';
 if(['gold','blue','fossil'].includes(id))return 'rare';
 if(['purple','red'].includes(id))return 'epic';
 if(['void','relic'].includes(id))return 'legendary';
 return 'common';
}

 ];
 for(const [k,v] of rows){
  const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='jx132-summary-row';
  d.innerHTML='<span>'+k+'</span><b>'+v+'</b>';host.append(d);
 }
 if(summary.legendary.length){
  const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='jx132-summary-special';d.textContent='✦ LEGENDARY · '+summary.legendary.join(' · ');host.append(d);
 }
 if(summary.secrets.length){
  const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='jx132-summary-special';d.textContent='◆ SECRETS · '+summary.secrets.join(' · ');host.append(d);
 }
 if(summary.finds?.length){
  const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='jx132-summary-special jx140-find-summary';d.textContent='◇ NEW COLLECTION · '+summary.finds.join(' · ');host.append(d);
 }
 if(summary.worldComplete){
  const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='jx132-summary-world';d.textContent='★ WORLD COMPLETE';host.append(d);
 }
 runCompleteOpen=true;
 $('jx132RunComplete').hidden=false;
 syncModalShield();renderWorlds();renderHUD();
}

function completionInfo(id){
 const loot=state.worldLoot[id]||[];
 const allLoot=worldPoolIds(id);
 const finds=worldFindIds(id);
 const lootDone=allLoot.filter(x=>loot.includes(x)).length;
 const findsDone=finds.filter(x=>(Number(state.collection[x])||0)>0).length;
 const legends=LEGENDS.filter(x=>x.world===id);
 const legDone=legends.filter(x=>hasFind(x.id)).length;
 const secretDone=(state.secrets[id]||[]).length;
 const guardian=!!state.guardianDefeated[id];
 const depth=(Number(state.bestDepth[id])||0)>=15;
 return {lootDone,lootTotal:allLoot.length,findsDone,findsTotal:finds.length,legDone,legTotal:legends.length,secretDone,secretTotal:2,guardian,depth,
  complete:lootDone===allLoot.length&&findsDone===finds.length&&legDone===legends.length&&secretDone>=2&&guardian&&depth};
}

function renderTabs(id){
 app.querySelectorAll('[data-jx900-tab]').forEach(b=>{b.setAttribute('aria-selected',String(b.dataset.jx900Tab===id));b.disabled=overlayOpen()});
 app.querySelectorAll('[data-jx900-pane]').forEach(p=>p.hidden=p.dataset.jx900Pane!==id);
 if(id==='workshop')renderWorkshop();
 if(id==='collection')renderCollection();
}
app.querySelectorAll('[data-jx900-tab]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(overlayOpen())return;renderTabs(b.dataset.jx900Tab)}));

function renderWorlds(){
 const host=$('jx900Worlds');host.replaceChildren();
 for(const w of WORLDS){
  const unlocked=state.totalSecured>=w.need;
  const c=completionInfo(w.id);
  const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='jx900-world';b.disabled=!unlocked||!!run||overlayOpen();
  b.style.backgroundImage=`url("${ROOT+w.map}")`;
  b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(state.world===w.id));
  const best=Math.max(0,Number(state.bestDepth[w.id])||0);
  b.innerHTML=`<strong>${unlocked?'⛏️':'🔒'} ${w.name}${c.complete?' ★':''}</strong><small>${unlocked?'BEST DEPTH '+best+' m · '+(c.complete?'WORLD COMPLETE':'RES '+c.lootDone+'/'+c.lootTotal+' · FINDS '+c.findsDone+'/'+c.findsTotal):'SECURE '+w.need+' ITEMS TO UNLOCK'}</small>`;
  b.onclick=()=>{if(run||!unlocked||overlayOpen())return;state.world=w.id;save();renderWorlds();renderHUD();say(w.name+' selected · START RUN when ready.')};
  host.append(b);
 }
}

 $('jx132PBText').textContent='PB '+(Number(state.bestDepth[state.world])||0)+' m';

 $('jx900MineBtn').textContent=eventOpen?'⏸ EVENT':!run?'▶ START RUN':run.guardian?`⚔ GUARDIAN ${run.guardian.hits}/3`:run.enemy?`⚔ FIGHT · ${run.enemy.hp}/${run.enemy.maxHp}`:timing?'⚡ SWING NOW':run.mined?'✓ NODE CLEARED':`⛏ STRIKE · ${run.nodeHp}/${run.nodeMaxHp}`;
 $('jx900MineBtn').disabled=overlayOpen()||!!run&&run.mined&&!timing&&!run.guardian&&!run.enemy;
 $('jx900DeeperBtn').disabled=!run||!run.mined||timing||overlayOpen()||!!run.guardian||!!run.enemy;
 $('jx900SecureBtn').disabled=!run||bagCount()===0||timing||overlayOpen()||!!run.guardian||!!run.enemy;
 $('jx900Room').classList.toggle('jx133-room-muted', eventOpen||secureOpen||runCompleteOpen);

 $('jx900Bag').replaceChildren();
 if(run&&bagCount()){

 }
}

function chooseNode(){
 const boost=(hasFind('old_dynamite')?1.15:1)*(1+dangerNow()/260);
 return weighted(POOLS[state.world],boost);
}
function chooseRoom(){
 const arr=world().bg;
 const section=Math.floor(Math.max(0,run.depth-1)/2);
 return arr[Math.abs(((section*7)+(state.runs*3))%arr.length)];
}

 descending=false;const desc=$('jx131Descend');if(desc)desc.hidden=true;
 cancelTiming();
 const room=$('jx900Room'),miner=$('jx900Miner'),node=$('jx900Node'),enemy=$('jx913Guardian'),
       hazard=$('jx900Hazard'),impact=$('jx900ImpactFx'),toolEl=$('jx900ToolSprite'),
       hp=$('jx134NodeHp'),pop=$('jx134LootPop');
 if(room){
  room.className='jx900-room';
  room.removeAttribute('data-danger');
  room.style.removeProperty('--jx-target-x');
  room.style.removeProperty('--jx-target-y');
  room.style.backgroundImage=`url("${ROOT+'mining_world_select_bg.png'}")`;
 }
 if(miner){
  miner.src=ROOT+'miner_idle.png';
  miner.style.cssText='';
  miner.hidden=false;
 }
 if(node){
  node.hidden=true;
  node.style.cssText='';
  node.classList.remove('jx134-node-hit');
  node.removeAttribute('data-damage');
 }
 if(enemy){
  enemy.hidden=true;
  enemy.style.cssText='';
  enemy.classList.remove('jx132-guardian-enter','jx141-enemy-hit');
 }
 if(hazard){hazard.hidden=true;hazard.style.cssText=''}
 if(impact){impact.hidden=true;impact.style.cssText=''}
 if(toolEl){toolEl.hidden=true;toolEl.style.cssText=''}
 if(hp)hp.hidden=true;
 if(pop){pop.hidden=true;pop.classList.remove('jx134-pop-active','jx140-bonus-pop')}
 $('jx900Timing').hidden=true;
 $('jx900RoomType').textContent='READY';
 $('jx900RoomType').dataset.kind='ready';
 $('jx900RoomLabel').textContent=label;
}

function roomKind(file){
 if(String(file).startsWith('event_'))return 'EVENT';
 if(String(file).includes('room_')||String(file).includes('special_'))return 'SPECIAL ROOM';
 return run?.depth>=10?'DEEP MINE':'MINE';
}
function nodeScale(id){return ({stone:1,coal:.92,copper:.94,iron:.96,gold:.92,blue:.90,purple:.90,red:.92,void:.90,fossil:1.08,relic:1.12}[id]||1)}
function nodeHits(id){
 return ({stone:3,coal:3,copper:3,iron:4,gold:4,blue:4,purple:5,red:5,void:5,fossil:4,relic:5}[id]||3);
}
function nodeProgressText(){
 if(!run?.node)return '';
 return 'HITS '+Math.max(0,run.nodeMaxHp-run.nodeHp)+'/'+run.nodeMaxHp;
}
function updateNodeDamageVisual(){
 const n=$('jx900Node'),g=$('jx913Guardian'),hp=$('jx134NodeHp');
 if(run?.enemy){
  const ratio=clamp(run.enemy.hp/run.enemy.maxHp,0,1);
  const scale=.82+.18*ratio;
  if(g){g.style.opacity=String(.70+.30*ratio);g.style.filter=(run.enemy.glow||'drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(255,120,80,.25))')+' drop-shadow(4px 6px 3px #0009)';g.style.transform='translateX(-50%) scale('+scale+')';}
  if(hp){hp.textContent=run.enemy.name+' · '+run.enemy.hp+'/'+run.enemy.maxHp+' HITS LEFT · guarding '+NODES[run.node].name.toUpperCase();hp.hidden=run.mined}
  return;
 }
 if(!n||!run?.node)return;
 const ratio=clamp(run.nodeHp/run.nodeMaxHp,0,1);
 const base=nodeScale(run.node);
 const shrink=.58+.42*ratio;
 n.style.setProperty('--jx900-node-scale',String(base*shrink));
 n.style.opacity=String(.62+.38*ratio);
 n.dataset.damage=ratio>.74?'fresh':ratio>.49?'chipped':ratio>.24?'cracked':'critical';
 if(hp){
  hp.textContent=NODES[run.node].name.toUpperCase()+' · '+run.nodeHp+'/'+run.nodeMaxHp+' HITS LEFT';
  hp.hidden=run.mined;
 }
}
function nodeHitKick(){
 const n=$('jx900Node');if(!n)return;
 n.classList.remove('jx134-node-hit');void n.offsetWidth;n.classList.add('jx134-node-hit');
 setTimeout(()=>n.classList.remove('jx134-node-hit'),260);
}
function lootPop(id,qty,bonus=null){
 const box=$('jx134LootPop'),img=$('jx134LootPopImg'),txt=$('jx134LootPopText');
 if(!box||!img||!txt)return;
 const show=(itemId,count,label='')=>{
  try{window.JXSound?.fx('minereward')}catch(_){}
  img.src=ROOT+itemArt(itemId);
  txt.textContent=(label?label+' · ':'')+itemName(itemId)+(count?' ×'+count:'');
  box.dataset.rarity=lootRarity(itemId);
  box.hidden=false;box.classList.remove('jx134-pop-active','jx140-bonus-pop');void box.offsetWidth;box.classList.add('jx134-pop-active');
 };
 clearTimeout(box._jx134Timer);clearTimeout(box._jx140BonusTimer);
 show(id,qty);
 if(bonus){
  box._jx140BonusTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
   show(bonus.id,1,'✦ '+bonus.rarity.toUpperCase()+' FIND');
   box.classList.add('jx140-bonus-pop');
  },720);
  box._jx134Timer=setTimeout(()=>{box.classList.remove('jx134-pop-active','jx140-bonus-pop');box.hidden=true},1780);
 }else{
  box._jx134Timer=setTimeout(()=>{box.classList.remove('jx134-pop-active');box.hidden=true},980);
 }
}

function syncRoomSprites(){
 const n=$('jx900Node'),m=$('jx900Miner'),toolEl=$('jx900ToolSprite');
 if(run?.enemy){updateNodeDamageVisual();applyRoomLayout('enemy')}
 else if(run?.guardian){applyRoomLayout('guardian')}
 else if(run?.node){n.dataset.kind=NODES[run.node]?.kind||'ORE';updateNodeDamageVisual();applyRoomLayout('node')}
 toolEl.hidden=!timing;
 m.dataset.state=timing?'mining':run?.mined?'cleared':'idle';
}


function lootRows(){
 if(!run)return [];
 return Object.entries(run.bag)
  .filter(([,count])=>count>0)
  .map(([id,count])=>({
    id,count,
    name:itemName(id),
    art:itemArt(id),
    value:itemValue(id)*count
  }));
}
function openSecurePopup(){
 if(!run||timing||eventOpen||descending||run.guardian||run.enemy)return;
 secureOpen=true;
 const host=$('jx131SecureItems');host.replaceChildren();
 const rows=lootRows();
 if(!rows.length){
  const empty=document.createElement('div');empty.className='jx131-secure-empty';empty.textContent='NO LOOT COLLECTED YET';host.append(empty);
 }
 for(const row of rows){
  const item=document.createElement('div');item.className='jx131-secure-item rarity-'+lootRarity(row.id);
  const img=document.createElement('img');img.src=ROOT+row.art;img.alt=row.name;
  const txt=document.createElement('div');txt.innerHTML='<strong>'+row.name+'</strong><span>×'+row.count+' · '+Math.round(row.value*valueMult())+' ₥ base</span>';
  item.append(img,txt);host.append(item);
 }
 $('jx131SecureCount').textContent=bagCount();
 $('jx131SecureValue').textContent=Math.round(run.value)+' ₥';
 $('jx131SecurePopup').hidden=false;

}
function descendTransition(){
 if(!run||!run.mined||timing||eventOpen||secureOpen||run.guardian||run.enemy)return;

 const now=performance.now();
 if(run._descendLockUntil&&now<run._descendLockUntil)return;
 run._descendLockUntil=now+850;

 try{window.JXSound?.fx('minewalk')}catch(_){}

 const overlay=$('jx131Descend');
 const title=overlay?.querySelector('strong');
 const fromDepth=run.depth;
 const oldState={
  depth:run.depth,
  mined:run.mined,
  node:run.node,
  room:run.room,
  hazard:run.hazard,
  enemy:run.enemy,
  guardian:run.guardian,
  nodeMaxHp:run.nodeMaxHp,
  nodeHp:run.nodeHp,
  nodeQuality:run.nodeQuality,
  nodeStrikes:run.nodeStrikes,
  danger:run.danger
 };

 const nextDanger=clamp(Math.round(worldDangerBase()+(run.depth+1)*2.2+(run.danger||0)+1.5),0,100);
 const hazardPct=Math.min(50,Math.round((.08+nextDanger*.0035)*100));

 if(overlay){
  overlay.hidden=false;
  overlay.classList.remove('jx143-descend-active');
  void overlay.offsetWidth;
  overlay.classList.add('jx143-descend-active');
 }
 if(title)title.textContent='DESCENDING...';
 $('jx131DescendDepth').textContent='DEPTH '+run.depth+' → '+(run.depth+1)+' m · RISK +2% · HAZARD '+hazardPct+'%';

 // Critical difference from older builds:
 // load the next room NOW, not from a timer callback.
 // The browser paints the black transition over the already-loaded room.
 try{
  enterRoom();

  let announce='DEPTH REACHED';
  if(run?.guardian)announce='⚠ GUARDIAN DETECTED';
  else if(run?.enemy)announce='⚠ MONSTER DETECTED';
  else if(eventOpen)announce='⚠ SPECIAL SIGNAL';
  else{
   const k=roomKind(run.room);
   if(k==='SPECIAL ROOM')announce='◆ SPECIAL ROOM';
   else if(k==='DEEP MINE')announce='▼ DEEP SECTION';
  }
  if(title)title.textContent=announce;
 }catch(err){
  console.error('[MINING] Immediate descend load failed',err);

  // Fully restore the previous playable room state.
  Object.assign(run,oldState);
  run.mined=true;
  try{
   if(run.room)$('jx900Room').style.backgroundImage=`url("${ROOT+run.room}")`;
   if(run.node&&NODES[run.node]){
    $('jx900Node').src=ROOT+NODES[run.node].node;
    $('jx900Node').hidden=!!run.mined;
   }
   $('jx913Guardian').hidden=!run.enemy&&!run.guardian;
   syncRoomSprites();
   renderHUD();
   say('LOAD RECOVERED · You can try GO DEEPER again or SECURE LOOT.');
  }catch(_){}
  if(title)title.textContent='LOAD RECOVERED';
 }

 // Never use descending as a gameplay lock.
 descending=false;
 renderHUD();
 syncModalShield();

 // Purely cosmetic cleanup. Even if this callback never fires,
 // CSS animation makes the overlay invisible and it never catches taps.
 clearTimeout(overlay?._jx143HideTimer);
 if(overlay){
  overlay._jx143HideTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
   overlay.hidden=true;
   overlay.classList.remove('jx143-descend-active');
   if(title)title.textContent='DESCENDING...';
  },950);
 }
}

function showEvent(evt){
 eventOpen=true;
 const dialog=$('jx913Event');
 dialog.hidden=false;
 dialog.scrollTop=0;
 $('jx913EventArt').src=ROOT+evt.art;
 $('jx913EventTitle').textContent=evt.title;
 $('jx913EventText').textContent=evt.text;
 const host=$('jx913EventChoices');host.replaceChildren();
 evt.choices.forEach(([label,fn,need])=>{
  const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='retro-btn';b.type='button';b.style.pointerEvents='auto';
  b.textContent=(need&&!hasFind(need)?'🔒 ':'')+label;
  b.disabled=!!need&&!hasFind(need);
  b.onclick=()=>{
   if(!eventOpen)return;
   eventOpen=false;
   $('jx913Event').hidden=true;
   $('jx913EventChoices').replaceChildren();
   const result=fn(run);
   syncModalShield();renderHUD();say(result+' · Continue mining or secure your loot.');
   if(run&& (run.energy<=0||run.light<=0))collapse(result);
  };
  host.append(b);
 });
 syncModalShield();renderHUD();
}
function maybeEvent(){
 if(!run||run.depth<2||run.guardian)return false;
 const chance=.18+Math.min(.18,dangerNow()*.0015);
 if(Math.random()>=chance)return false;
 const pool=EVENTS[state.world];
 let candidates=pool.filter(e=>!(run.seenEvents||[]).includes(e.id));
 if(!candidates.length){run.seenEvents=[];candidates=pool}
 const evt=rnd(candidates);
 run.seenEvents.push(evt.id);
 showEvent(evt);return true;
}
function discoverSecret(secret){
 if(!state.secrets[state.world].includes(secret.id)){state.secrets[state.world].push(secret.id);if(run)run.newSecrets.push(secret.name)}
 addBag(secret.reward[0],secret.reward[1]);save();
 showEvent({title:'✦ SECRET DISCOVERED · '+secret.name,art:secret.art,text:secret.text+' Reward: '+NODES[secret.reward[0]].name+' ×'+secret.reward[1]+'.',
  choices:[['TAKE FIND',()=>{return 'Secret logged in the world record.'}]]});
}
function maybeSecret(){
 const unseen=SECRETS[state.world].filter(s=>!state.secrets[state.world].includes(s.id));
 if(!unseen.length||run.depth<4||Math.random()>=secretChance())return false;
 discoverSecret(rnd(unseen));return true;
}
function maybeWeirdMoment(){
 if(run.depth<6||Math.random()>.012)return false;
 const weird=[
  ['YOU HAVE BEEN HERE BEFORE.','event_void_anomaly.png','The room label briefly changes to DEPTH: ???.'],
  ['MINER_02 DETECTED','mining_deep_void_core.png','For one frame, another miner stands where you are supposed to be.'],
  ['INVALID SHAFT','mining_object_void_rift.png','A tunnel appears on the map, then deletes itself.']
 ];
 const [title,art,txt]=rnd(weird);
 showEvent({title,art,text:txt,choices:[['CONTINUE',r=>{r.danger+=8;return 'The mine stabilizes, mostly.'}]]});return true;
}

 $('jx900RoomType').textContent='MONSTER';
 $('jx900RoomType').dataset.kind='monster';
 $('jx900RoomLabel').textContent=world().name+' · MONSTER DEN · '+monster.name+' · '+NODES[run.node].name.toUpperCase();

function maybeMonster(){

 if(Math.random()>=monsterChance())return false;
 startMonster(rnd(MONSTERS[state.world]));
 return true;
}

function guardianReward(){
 state.guardianDefeated[state.world]=true;
 run.guardian=null;$('jx913Guardian').hidden=true;run.mined=true;
 addBag(state.world==='void'?'void':state.world==='magma'?'red':state.world==='crystal'?'purple':'gold',5);
 addBag('relic',2);
 run.value+=120+run.depth*5;run.focus+=3;
 save();renderHUD();renderWorlds();renderCollection();
 say('GUARDIAN DEFEATED · +5 rare resource · +2 Relics · +3 Focus. The world remembers this.');
}

function enterRoom(){
 run.depth++;run.mined=false;run.enemy=null;run.node=chooseNode();run.room=chooseRoom();run.hazard=null;
 run.nodeMaxHp=nodeHits(run.node);run.nodeHp=run.nodeMaxHp;run.nodeQuality=0;run.nodeStrikes=0;
 run.danger+=1.5;
 $('jx900Room').style.backgroundImage=`url("${ROOT+run.room}")`;
 $('jx900Node').src=ROOT+NODES[run.node].node;$('jx900Node').hidden=false;
 $('jx134NodeHp').hidden=false;$('jx134LootPop').hidden=true;
 $('jx900Hazard').hidden=true;$('jx900ImpactFx').hidden=true;$('jx913Guardian').hidden=true;
 $('jx900Miner').src=ROOT+'miner_idle.png';
 const kind=roomKind(run.room);
 $('jx900RoomType').textContent=kind;$('jx900RoomType').dataset.kind=kind.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,'-');
 $('jx900RoomLabel').textContent=world().name+' · '+kind+' · DEPTH '+run.depth+' m · '+NODES[run.node].name.toUpperCase();
 applyRoomLayout('node');syncRoomSprites();renderHUD();
 if(maybeGuardian()||maybeSecret()||maybeWeirdMoment()||maybeEvent()||maybeMonster())return;
 say('Node detected: '+NODES[run.node].name+' · '+run.nodeMaxHp+' hits to break.');
}
function startRun(){
 clearOverlayContents();resetRoomScene();cancelTiming();
 runCompleteOpen=false;syncModalShield();run={depth:0,energy:maxEnergy(),light:startLight(),bag:{},value:0,mined:false,node:null,room:null,hazard:null,focus:0,danger:0,guardian:null,guardianSeen:false,enemy:null,newLegendary:[],newSecrets:[],newFinds:[],seenEvents:[],secondaryPity:0};
 state.runs++;save();renderWorlds();enterRoom();
}

function startTiming(){
 if(!run||run.mined||timing||eventOpen)return;
 timing=true;t0=performance.now();marker=.04;direction=1;
 $('jx900Timing').hidden=false;$('jx900Room').classList.add('jx900-mining');
 miningFrame=0;$('jx900Miner').src=ROOT+'miner_mining_1.png';syncRoomSprites();
 const z=zoneWidth();$('jx900Sweet').style.left=((.5-z/2)*100)+'%';$('jx900Sweet').style.width=(z*100)+'%';
 say(run.guardian?'GUARDIAN STRIKE · hit inside the green zone.':run.enemy?'MONSTER STRIKE · '+run.enemy.name+' · '+run.enemy.hp+' hits left · tap again inside the green zone.':'STRIKE '+(run.nodeStrikes+1)+' · '+run.nodeHp+' hits left · tap again inside the green zone.');
 function tick(t){
  if(!timing)return;
  const speed=.00062+(run.depth*.000006)+dangerNow()*.0000015;
  marker+=(t-(t0||t))*speed*direction;t0=t;
  if(marker>=.985){marker=.985;direction=-1} if(marker<=.015){marker=.015;direction=1}
  $('jx900Marker').style.left=(marker*100)+'%';
  const f=Math.floor(t/150)%2;
  if(f!==miningFrame){miningFrame=f;$('jx900Miner').src=ROOT+(f?'miner_mining_2.png':'miner_mining_1.png')}
  raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);
 }
 raf=requestAnimationFrame(tick);renderHUD();
}
function cancelTiming(){
 timing=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);raf=0;t0=0;$('jx900Timing').hidden=true;$('jx900Room').classList.remove('jx900-mining');syncRoomSprites()
}

function monsterHitFx(mode='good'){
 const room=$('jx900Room'),enemy=$('jx913Guardian'),pulse=$('jx900PulseFx');
 if(!room||!enemy||!pulse)return;
 try{window.JXSound?.fx('monsterhit')}catch(_){}
 $('jx900ImpactFx').hidden=true;
 room.classList.remove('jx141-monster-good','jx141-monster-perfect','jx141-monster-rough');
 enemy.classList.remove('jx141-enemy-hit');
 void room.offsetWidth;
 room.classList.add(mode==='perfect'?'jx141-monster-perfect':mode==='rough'?'jx141-monster-rough':'jx141-monster-good');
 enemy.classList.add('jx141-enemy-hit');
 clearTimeout(room._jx141MonsterTimer);
 room._jx141MonsterTimer=setTimeout(()=>{
  room.classList.remove('jx141-monster-good','jx141-monster-perfect','jx141-monster-rough');
  enemy.classList.remove('jx141-enemy-hit');
 },430);
}

function hitFx(mode='good'){
 const room=$('jx900Room'),img=$('jx900ImpactFx'),pulse=$('jx900PulseFx');if(!room||!img||!pulse)return;
 img.src=ROOT+(state.world==='void'?'fx_void_glitch.png':'fx_rock_debris.png');img.hidden=false;
 room.classList.remove('jx903-hitfx','jx903-perfectfx','jx903-roughfx');void room.offsetWidth;
 room.classList.add(mode==='perfect'?'jx903-perfectfx':mode==='rough'?'jx903-roughfx':'jx903-hitfx');
 clearTimeout(room._jx903FxTimer);room._jx903FxTimer=setTimeout(()=>{img.hidden=true;room.classList.remove('jx903-hitfx','jx903-perfectfx','jx903-roughfx')},720);
}
function hazardFx(){const room=$('jx900Room');room.classList.remove('jx903-hazardfx');void room.offsetWidth;room.classList.add('jx903-hazardfx');setTimeout(()=>room.classList.remove('jx903-hazardfx'),720)}
function secureFx(){const room=$('jx900Room');room.classList.remove('jx903-securefx');void room.offsetWidth;room.classList.add('jx903-securefx');setTimeout(()=>room.classList.remove('jx903-securefx'),800)}

function maybeLegendary(){
 const candidates=LEGENDS.filter(x=>x.world===state.world&&!hasFind(x.id));
 if(!candidates.length||Math.random()>=legendaryChance())return null;
 const f=rnd(candidates);state.legendary.push(f.id);if(run)run.newLegendary.push(f.name);save();return f;
}
function maybeHazard(){
 const chance=Math.min(.50,.08+dangerNow()*.0035);
 if(Math.random()>=chance)return null;
 const h=rnd(HAZARDS[state.world]);run.energy-=h[2];run.light-=h[3];run.hazard=h;
 $('jx900Hazard').src=ROOT+h[1];$('jx900Hazard').hidden=false;hazardFx();
 clearTimeout($('jx900Hazard')._jx903HideTimer);$('jx900Hazard')._jx903HideTimer=setTimeout(()=>{$('jx900Hazard').hidden=true},1350);
 return h;
}

function resolveMine(){
 if(!timing||!run)return;
 const z=zoneWidth(),dist=Math.abs(marker-.5),inside=dist<=z/2,perfect=dist<=z*.16;
 cancelTiming();

 if(run.guardian){
  if(inside){
   run.guardian.hits++;run.focus+=perfect?2:1;hitFx(perfect?'perfect':'good');
   if(run.guardian.hits>=3){guardianReward();return}
   say((perfect?'PERFECT':'GOOD')+' GUARDIAN HIT · '+run.guardian.hits+'/3');
  }else{
   run.energy-=14;run.focus=0;run.danger+=7;hitFx('rough');
   if(run.energy<=0){collapse('The Guardian crushes your position.');return}
   say('ROUGH GUARDIAN HIT · -14 Energy · Focus lost.');
  }
  renderHUD();return;
 }

 if(run.enemy){
  run.nodeStrikes++;
  run.enemy.hp=Math.max(0,run.enemy.hp-1);
  run.nodeQuality+=(perfect?2:inside?1:0);
  run.energy-=inside?3.2:5.2;
  run.light-=inside?1.6:2.6;
  if(perfect)run.focus=Math.min(10,run.focus+2);
  else if(inside)run.focus=Math.min(10,run.focus+1);
  else run.focus=0;
  monsterHitFx(perfect?'perfect':inside?'good':'rough');
  updateNodeDamageVisual();
  $('jx900Miner').src=ROOT+'miner_idle.png';
  if(run.energy<=0||run.light<=0){renderHUD();collapse('The '+run.enemy.name+' drives you back before the vein can be recovered.');return}
  if(run.enemy.hp>0){
   syncRoomSprites();renderHUD();
   say((perfect?'PERFECT':inside?'GOOD':'ROUGH')+' HIT · '+run.enemy.name+' · '+run.enemy.hp+'/'+run.enemy.maxHp+' hits left.');
   return;
  }
  const avgQuality=run.nodeQuality/Math.max(1,run.nodeStrikes);
  const qualityQty=avgQuality>=1.55?3:avgQuality>=.75?2:1;
  const qty=Math.max(1,Math.round(qualityQty*yieldMult(run.node)));
  run.mined=true;addBag(run.node,qty);
  const bonusFind=rollSecondaryFind(run.node);
  if(bonusFind){addBag(bonusFind.id,1);run.value+=bonusFind.value;if((Number(state.collection[bonusFind.id])||0)===0&&!run.newFinds.includes(bonusFind.name))run.newFinds.push(bonusFind.name)}
  const gain=Math.round((NODES[run.node].value*qty+run.enemy.bonus)*valueMult()*(1+run.focus*.02));
  run.value+=gain;run.focus=Math.min(10,run.focus+1);
  $('jx913Guardian').hidden=true;$('jx134NodeHp').hidden=true;
  lootPop(run.node,qty,bonusFind);
  const monsterName=run.enemy.name;
  run.enemy=null;
  syncRoomSprites();
  let msg='MONSTER DOWN · '+monsterName+' cleared · '+NODES[run.node].name+' ×'+qty+' secured · +'+gain+' ₥ potential.';
  if(bonusFind)msg+=' ◇ '+bonusFind.rarity.toUpperCase()+' FIND: '+bonusFind.name+'.';
  const find=maybeLegendary();if(find)msg+=' ✦ LEGENDARY FIND: '+find.name+' · '+find.effect+'.';
  const hazard=maybeHazard();if(hazard)msg+=' ⚠ '+hazard[0]+' · -'+hazard[2]+' Energy / -'+hazard[3]+' Light.';
  if(run.energy<=0||run.light<=0){renderHUD();collapse(msg);return}
  renderHUD();renderWorlds();if(find)renderCollection();say(msg+' Go deeper or secure loot.');
  return;
 }

 try{window.JXSound?.fx('minehit')}catch(_){}

 run.nodeStrikes++;
 run.nodeHp=Math.max(0,run.nodeHp-1);
 run.nodeQuality+=(perfect?2:inside?1:0);

 const perHitEnergy=Math.max(2.2,((12+run.depth*.30)*tool().energy)/run.nodeMaxHp)*(inside?.86:1.12);
 const perHitLight=Math.max(1.2,((5+run.depth*.18)*lightMult())/run.nodeMaxHp)*(inside?.90:1.08);
 run.energy-=perHitEnergy;run.light-=perHitLight;

 if(perfect)run.focus=Math.min(10,run.focus+2);
 else if(inside)run.focus=Math.min(10,run.focus+1);
 else run.focus=0;

 hitFx(perfect?'perfect':inside?'good':'rough');
 nodeHitKick();
 updateNodeDamageVisual();
 $('jx900Miner').src=ROOT+'miner_idle.png';

 if(run.energy<=0||run.light<=0){
  renderHUD();collapse((perfect?'PERFECT':inside?'GOOD':'ROUGH')+' STRIKE · the node remains unfinished.');return
 }

 if(run.nodeHp>0){
  syncRoomSprites();renderHUD();
  say((perfect?'PERFECT':inside?'GOOD':'ROUGH')+' STRIKE · '+NODES[run.node].name+' · '+run.nodeHp+'/'+run.nodeMaxHp+' hits left · FOCUS x'+run.focus+'.');
  return;
 }

 const avgQuality=run.nodeQuality/Math.max(1,run.nodeStrikes);
 const qualityQty=avgQuality>=1.55?3:avgQuality>=.75?2:1;
 const qty=Math.max(1,Math.round(qualityQty*yieldMult(run.node)));
 run.mined=true;addBag(run.node,qty);
 const bonusFind=rollSecondaryFind(run.node);
 if(bonusFind){addBag(bonusFind.id,1);run.value+=bonusFind.value;if((Number(state.collection[bonusFind.id])||0)===0&&!run.newFinds.includes(bonusFind.name))run.newFinds.push(bonusFind.name)}
 const gain=Math.round(NODES[run.node].value*qty*valueMult()*(1+run.focus*.02));run.value+=gain;

 $('jx900Node').hidden=true;$('jx134NodeHp').hidden=true;
 lootPop(run.node,qty,bonusFind);
 syncRoomSprites();

 let msg='NODE BROKEN · '+NODES[run.node].name+' ×'+qty+' · +'+gain+' ₥ potential · '+run.nodeStrikes+' swings · FOCUS x'+run.focus+'.';
 if(bonusFind)msg+=' ◇ '+bonusFind.rarity.toUpperCase()+' FIND: '+bonusFind.name+'.';
 const find=maybeLegendary();if(find)msg+=' ✦ LEGENDARY FIND: '+find.name+' · '+find.effect+'.';
 const hazard=maybeHazard();if(hazard)msg+=' ⚠ '+hazard[0]+' · -'+hazard[2]+' Energy / -'+hazard[3]+' Light.';
 if(run.energy<=0||run.light<=0){renderHUD();collapse(msg);return}
 renderHUD();renderWorlds();if(find)renderCollection();say(msg+' Go deeper or secure loot.');
}
function goDeeper(){descendTransition()}

function actualSecure(){
 if(!run||timing||eventOpen||run.guardian)return;
 secureOpen=false;$('jx131SecurePopup').hidden=true;syncModalShield();
 secureFx();cancelTiming();
 const items=bagCount(),value=Math.max(0,Math.round(run.value)),depth=run.depth,wid=state.world;
 const oldPB=Number(state.bestDepth[wid])||0;
 const summaryBase={world:worldName(wid),depth,items,value,focus:run.focus,danger:dangerNow(),legendary:[...run.newLegendary],secrets:[...run.newSecrets],finds:[...run.newFinds],pb:depth>oldPB};
 for(const [id,count] of Object.entries(run.bag)){
  if(!count)continue;
  state.collection[id]=(Number(state.collection[id])||0)+count;
  if(!state.worldLoot[wid].includes(id))state.worldLoot[wid].push(id);
  const meta=state.collectionMeta[id]||{};
  state.collectionMeta[id]={
   firstFound:meta.firstFound||Date.now(),
   firstDepth:meta.firstDepth??depth,
   firstWorld:meta.firstWorld||wid,
   deepest:Math.max(Number(meta.deepest)||0,depth),
   lastWorld:wid
  };
 }
 state.totalSecured+=items;state.bestDepth[wid]=Math.max(Number(state.bestDepth[wid])||0,depth);
 save();
 if(value>0)try{window.JXShopCredit?.(value,'MINING.EXE · SECURED LOOT')}catch(_){}
 document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('jx:mining-secured',{detail:{world:wid,depth,items,value}}));
 const complete=completionInfo(wid);
 const runSummary={...summaryBase,worldComplete:complete.complete};
 run=null;
 eventOpen=false;secureOpen=false;descending=false;
 clearOverlayContents();
 resetRoomScene('LOOT SECURED · '+items+' ITEMS · DEPTH '+depth+' m');
 renderWorlds();renderHUD();renderCollection();
 if(complete.complete&&!state.worldCompleteSeen[wid]){state.worldCompleteSeen[wid]=true;save()}
 showRunComplete(runSummary);
 say('SECURED · '+items+' items banked · +'+value+' ₥ Jonas Coins.');
}
function secure(){openSecurePopup()}
function collapse(prefix=''){
 if(!run)return;
 const lost=bagCount(),depth=run.depth;state.bestDepth[state.world]=Math.max(Number(state.bestDepth[state.world])||0,depth);save();
 run=null;eventOpen=false;secureOpen=false;descending=false;runCompleteOpen=false;
 $('jx131Descend').hidden=true;clearOverlayContents();syncModalShield();
 resetRoomScene('RUN FAILED · UNSECURED LOOT LOST');
 renderWorlds();renderHUD();say(prefix+' RUN FAILED at '+depth+' m · '+lost+' unsecured items lost.');
}

function renderWorkshop(){
 const host=$('jx900Workshop');host.replaceChildren();
 TOOLS.forEach((t,i)=>{
  const unlocked=state.totalSecured>=t.need,owned=state.owned.includes(i),active=state.tool===i;
  const c=document.createElement('div');c.className='jx900-tool-card'+(active?' active':'');
  const img=document.createElement('img');img.src=ROOT+t.art;img.alt=t.name;
  const box=document.createElement('div'),title=document.createElement('strong'),desc=document.createElement('small'),gate=document.createElement('small'),b=document.createElement('button');
  title.textContent=t.name;desc.textContent=t.desc;gate.textContent=unlocked?(t.need?'✓ ACCESS · '+t.need+' SECURED ITEMS':'✓ STARTER'):'🔒 NEED '+t.need+' SECURED ITEMS';
  b.className='retro-btn';b.type='button';b.textContent=active?'✓ EQUIPPED':!unlocked?'🔒 LOCKED':owned?'EQUIP':'BUY '+t.cost+' ₥';b.disabled=active||!unlocked||!!run||overlayOpen();
  b.onclick=()=>{if(run||!unlocked||overlayOpen())return;if(!owned){if(!window.JXShopSpend?.(t.cost)){say('Not enough Jonas Coins for '+t.name+'.');return}state.owned.push(i)}state.tool=i;save();renderWorkshop();renderHUD();say(t.name+' equipped.')};
  box.append(title,desc,gate,b);c.append(img,box);host.append(c);
 });
}

function renderWorldProgress(){
 const host=$('jx913WorldProgress');if(!host)return;host.replaceChildren();
 for(const w of WORLDS){
  const c=completionInfo(w.id),d=document.createElement('div');d.className='jx913-world-card'+(c.complete?' complete':'');
  d.innerHTML='<strong>'+w.name+(c.complete?' ★':'')+'</strong><span>RESOURCES '+c.lootDone+'/'+c.lootTotal+' · FINDS '+c.findsDone+'/'+c.findsTotal+' · LEGENDARY '+c.legDone+'/'+c.legTotal+' · SECRETS '+c.secretDone+'/2 · GUARDIAN '+(c.guardian?'✓':'—')+' · 15m '+(c.depth?'✓':'—')+'</span>';
  host.append(d);
 }
}

function cardMatchesFilter(type){
 return collectionFilter==='all'||collectionFilter===type;
}
function bindCollectionFilters(){
 app.querySelectorAll('[data-jx132-filter]').forEach(b=>{
  b.onclick=()=>{if(overlayOpen())return;collectionFilter=b.dataset.jx132Filter;app.querySelectorAll('[data-jx132-filter]').forEach(x=>x.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(x===b)));renderCollection()}
 });
}

function renderCollection(){
 $('jx900SecuredStat').textContent=state.totalSecured;$('jx900RunsStat').textContent=state.runs;$('jx900LegendaryStat').textContent=state.legendary.length+'/8';renderWorldProgress();
 const host=$('jx900Collection');host.replaceChildren();
 for(const o of ALL_LOOT){
  if(!cardMatchesFilter(o.kind))continue;
  const count=Number(state.collection[o.id])||0,c=document.createElement('div');
  c.className='jx900-item rarity-'+lootRarity(o.id)+(count?'':' locked');
  const img=document.createElement('img');img.src=ROOT+o.loot;img.alt=count?o.name:'Unknown item';
  const strong=document.createElement('strong');strong.textContent=count?o.name:'???';
  const meta=state.collectionMeta[o.id],small=document.createElement('small');
  if(count&&meta){
   const first=meta.firstDepth!=null?' · FIRST RECOVERED '+meta.firstDepth+'m '+worldName(meta.firstWorld):' · FIRST RECOVERED LEGACY SAVE';
   small.textContent=o.kind+' · '+lootRarity(o.id).toUpperCase()+' · ×'+count+' · DEEPEST '+meta.deepest+'m'+first+(o.desc?' · '+o.desc:'');
  }else small.textContent=count?o.kind+' · '+lootRarity(o.id).toUpperCase()+' · ×'+count:'UNDISCOVERED'+(o.world?' · '+worldName(o.world):'');
  c.append(img,strong,small);host.append(c);
 }
 if(cardMatchesFilter('legendary'))for(const f of LEGENDS){
  const got=hasFind(f.id),c=document.createElement('div');c.className='jx900-item jx900-legendary rarity-legendary'+(got?'':' locked');
  const img=document.createElement('img');img.src=ROOT+f.art;img.alt=got?f.name:'Unknown legendary find';
  const strong=document.createElement('strong');strong.textContent=got?f.name:'??? LEGENDARY';
  const small=document.createElement('small');small.textContent=got?f.effect:'UNDISCOVERED · '+WORLDS.find(w=>w.id===f.world).name;
  c.append(img,strong,small);host.append(c);
 }
 if(cardMatchesFilter('secret'))for(const w of WORLDS)for(const s of SECRETS[w.id]){
  const got=state.secrets[w.id].includes(s.id),c=document.createElement('div');c.className='jx900-item jx913-secret rarity-epic'+(got?'':' locked');
  const img=document.createElement('img');img.src=ROOT+s.art;img.alt=got?s.name:'Unknown secret';
  const strong=document.createElement('strong');strong.textContent=got?s.name:'??? SECRET';
  const small=document.createElement('small');small.textContent=got?s.text:'UNDISCOVERED · '+w.name;
  c.append(img,strong,small);host.append(c);
 }
}

$('jx900MineBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!run)startRun();else if(timing)resolveMine();else if(run.guardian)startTiming();else if(!run.mined)startTiming()});
$('jx900DeeperBtn').addEventListener('click',goDeeper);
$('jx900SecureBtn').addEventListener('click',secure);
$('jx131SecureConfirm').addEventListener('click',actualSecure);
$('jx131SecureCancel').addEventListener('click',closeSecurePopup);
$('jx132RunClose').addEventListener('click',closeRunComplete);
app.querySelector('[data-close="miningGame"]')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{eventOpen=false;secureOpen=false;runCompleteOpen=false;clearOverlayContents();syncModalShield();});

mountMiningOverlays();
bindCollectionFilters();renderWorlds();renderHUD();renderWorkshop();renderCollection();
resetRoomScene();
})();
